methods.name: createDisbursement
methods.desc: `reclaimTo` is unrestricted: what it can receive is the spending account's own funds.

methods.name: createDisbursement
methods.desc: The pre-reclaim-target selector: records no reclaim target.

methods.name: claimLegacyRewards
methods.desc: `claimRewards` against the legacy Rewards app pinned at create (refused when there is none).

methods.name: reclaimLegacyRewards
methods.desc: `reclaimRewards` against the legacy Rewards app pinned at create (refused when there is none).

methods.name: withdrawMbrCredits
methods.desc: Withdraws the wallet's unused MBR credits of a disbursement it created (STAKE-4).

methods.name: closeDisbursement
methods.desc:
Deletes an empty disbursement the wallet created and refunds its box MBR and credits (STAKE-4).
The legacy (v1) Rewards app has no `closeDisbursement`; recover its credits with `withdrawMbrCredits`.

methods.name: claimInbox
methods.desc: Claim an ASA from the wallet's ARC-59 inbox, opting the spending account in first when needed.

methods.name: rejectInbox
methods.desc: Reject an ASA in the wallet's ARC-59 inbox, returning it to the asset creator.

methods.name: claimInboxAlgo
methods.desc:
Recover ALGO above the inbox's minimum balance. ARC-59 recommends this before claimInbox when the
inbox holds extra receiver funding for the asset opt-in.

legacyRewards.desc:
The previous Rewards app (0 = none). Fixed at create: the registry only names the current
Rewards app, so this is the one other app whose credits, boxes and allocations the plugin may reach
(STAKE-4, DEC-1).

inboxRouter.desc: The ARC-59 ASA inbox router whose inboxes the claimInbox methods reach (0 = none). Fixed at create.

version.desc: the current version of the contract

akitaDAO.desc: the app ID of the Akita DAO
